sources.finding: Transit effects are classified as more than four favorable dots (good), exactly four (neutral), fewer than four (adverse); the explanation contrasts beneficial and adverse counts.

sources.locator: PDF p397, printed p655, Mars example

sources.finding: The text says the tenth place from the natal Moon has no benefic or malefic weight in the Mars Ashtakavarga example; its affected sign has three favorable dots and four unfavorable strokes rather than three and five.

sources.locator: PDF p397, printed p655, N.B. note
sources.finding: Upachaya/Apachaya modifiers are counted from natal Ascendant or natal Moon, NOT positions reached by planets in transit.

neutral_state: Only the Jataka commentary's stated Mars-from-Moon-tenth treatment is considered neutral; no blanket extension to other source schools without textual evidence.
